labels.label: unlabelled:analytic-structure (RamcovGX.tex:293, 341)

hypotheses.note: bundled in AnalyticStructure; each theorem asks only what it uses
IsRigidAction alone suffices everywhere except the uniqueness of phi, which uses IsAnalyticAction

findings: l.293 and l.341 give two different definitions of an analytical structure: l.293 asks X locally PATH-connected Hausdorff and 'agree on a nontrivial open set => g = h'; l.341 asks X connected, LOCALLY connected Hausdorff, a FAITHFUL action and 'agree on an open set => agree on X'. The two rigidity formulations are equivalent for nonempty X (GX.isAnalyticAction_iff); the topological hypotheses differ, and the library uses only l.341's local connectedness.
l.341 typo: 'if the action of $\phi_1$ and $\phi_1$ agree on $\U$' should read $\phi_1$ and $\phi_2$.

labels.label: unlabelled:GX-atlas (RamcovGX.tex:342-343)

hypotheses.note: HasGroupoid -> IsGXAtlas needs only IsRigidAction; IsGXAtlas -> HasGroupoid needs only LocallyConnectedSpace X; uniqueness of phi needs both local connectedness and IsAnalyticAction

questions: The paper's atlas is an indexed family (U_i,V_i,phi_i); it is read as a set of OpenPartialHomeomorph M X (repetitions change nothing). The per-component phi is read on connectedComponentIn (e.source ∩ e'.source) x.

labels.label: unlabelled:GX-morphism (dispatch reading; the paper uses it from l.480 without defining it for regular manifolds)

hypotheses.note: T2Space N, used by the closure step
IsRigidAction only; no HasGroupoid needed for analyticity, comp, local homeomorphism

findings: The paper never defines a (G,X)-morphism between (regular) (G,X)-manifolds although def:morphism (l.480) and lem:aepullback (l.549) rest on it; the reading taken is the standard one (continuous, locally a restriction of an element of G in charts), and it is shown chart independent over the maximal atlases.
questions: Reading of '(G,X)-morphism' for regular manifolds: continuous + in preferred charts near each point equal to g • chart. Equivalent to the same over all maximal-atlas charts (isGXMorphism_iff_maximalAtlas).

labels.label: unlabelled:pullback (RamcovGX.tex:549, 'by usual results', inside the proof of lem:aepullback)

hypotheses.paper: p a local homeomorphism (resp. covering map)
hypotheses.note: uniqueness (IsGXMorphism.maximalAtlas_eq) needs no hypothesis on p beyond being a morphism

questions: Uniqueness is stated as equality of maximal atlases (the structure), which is the paper's notion of (G,X)-structure; the ChartedSpace instances themselves (choice of chartAt) are not unique.

kb_proposals: gxGroupoid membership is pointwise: symm_trans_mem_gxGroupoid_iff (e' = g • e eventually near each overlap point); maximal-atlas membership is mem_maximalAtlas_iff_eventually — prove chart facts with filter_upwards, not with Opens.

Rigidity, not faithfulness, is what propagates a local translation along a connected component (exists_smul_eq_on_connectedComponentIn) and gives analyticity of morphisms; FaithfulSMul is needed only to make the g unique.

Two ChartedSpace instances on one M: state with @HasGroupoid X _ M _ cs G, @IsGXMorphism G X _ _ _ M _ N _ cs _ f and @StructureGroupoid.maximalAtlas X M _ _ cs G (M precedes the instances there); prove with letI := cs.
